description: This file defines a Java interface for reading dropdown options related to SMS campaigns, including methods to retrieve campaign trigger types, SMS providers, campaign types, weeks, months, and period frequency types.

classes.name: SmsCampaignDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for retrieving dropdown options related to SMS campaign configuration.

methods.name: retrieveCampaignTriggerTypes
methods.description: Retrieves campaign trigger types as a collection of EnumOptionData.

methods.name: retrieveSmsProviders
methods.description: Retrieves available SMS providers as a collection of SmsProviderData.

methods.name: retrieveCampaignTypes
methods.description: Retrieves campaign types as a collection of EnumOptionData.

methods.name: retrieveWeeks
methods.description: Retrieves week options as a collection of EnumOptionData.

methods.name: retrieveMonths
methods.description: Retrieves month options as a collection of EnumOptionData.

methods.name: retrivePeriodFrequencyTypes
methods.description: Retrieves period frequency types as a collection of EnumOptionData.
